name: Jenny Lake Loop
quote: The Jenny Lake Loop is a 7.1 mi (11.4 km) loop hike with 1,040 ft (320 m) of elevation gain.
why: A loop around Jenny Lake below the Cathedral Group, passing the Hidden Falls and Cascade Canyon junctions.

name: Hidden Falls Via South Jenny Lake Loop Trail
quote: Hidden Falls is a moderate, 4.9 mi (7.9 km) RT out and back hike with 620 ft (190 m) of elevation gain.
why: Around the south shore of Jenny Lake to a 100 ft cascade.

name: Hidden Falls Via Shuttle Boat
quote: Hidden Falls is an easy, 1 mi (1.6 km) RT out and back hike with 300 ft (90 m) of elevation gain.
why: The same falls reached from the west-shore boat dock.

name: Inspiration Point Via South Jenny Lake Loop Trail
quote: Inspiration Point is a moderate, 5.7 mi (9.2 km) RT out and back hike with 870 ft (270 m) of elevation gain.
why: Past Hidden Falls to a viewpoint above Jenny Lake, walking the south shore.

name: Inspiration Point Via Shuttle Boat
quote: Inspiration Point is an easy, 1.8 mi (2.9 km) RT out and back hike with 550 ft (170 m) of elevation gain.
why: The same viewpoint reached from the boat dock.

name: Forks of Cascade Canyon Via South Jenny Lake Loop Trail
quote: Cascade Canyon is a strenuous, 13.3 mi (21.4 km) RT out and back hike with 1,720 ft (520 m) of elevation gain.
why: Up a glacier-carved canyon between Teewinot and Mount St. John to its forks.

name: Forks of Cascade Canyon Via Shuttle Boat
quote: Cascade Canyon is a moderately strenuous, 9.4 mi (15.1 km) RT out and back hike with 1,480 ft (450 m) of elevation gain.
why: Cascade Canyon to the forks, starting from the boat dock.

name: Lake Solitude Via Shuttle Boat
quote: Lake Solitude is a strenuous, 14.4 mi (23.2 km) RT out and back hike with 2,670 ft (810 m) of elevation gain.
why: Through Cascade Canyon and up the North Fork to an alpine lake.

name: Lake Solitude Via South Jenny Lake Loop Trail
quote: Lake Solitude is a very strenuous, 18.3 mi (29.5 km) RT out and back hike with 2,910 ft (890 m) of elevation gain.
why: Lake Solitude without the boat, around Jenny Lake's south shore.

name: Taggart Lake
quote: Taggart Lake is an easy, 3 mi (4.8 km) RT out and back hike with 360 ft (110 m) of elevation gain.
why: An easy walk to a moraine lake at the foot of the Grand Teton.

name: Taggart Lake - Bradley Lake Loop
quote: The Taggart Lake - Bradley Lake Loop is a moderate, 5.6 mi (9 km) RT loop trail with 860 ft (262 m) of elevation gain.
why: A loop over the moraines to two lakes below the range.

name: Surprise and Amphitheater Lakes
quote: Surprise and Amphitheater Lakes is a strenuous, 9.8 mi (15.8 km) RT out and back hike with 3,070 ft (940 m) of elevation gain.
why: Switchbacks from Lupine Meadows up to two alpine lakes below Disappointment Peak.

name: Garnet Canyon
quote: Garnet Canyon is a strenuous, 8.2 mi (13.2 km) RT out and back hike with 2,430 ft (740 m) of elevation gain.
why: From Lupine Meadows into the canyon under the Grand, Middle and South Tetons, with boulder fields.

name: Static Peak Divide Trail
quote: Static Peak Divide is a very strenuous, 16 mi (25.7 km) RT out and back hike with 5,590 ft (1,700 m) of elevation gain.
why: A full-day climb out of Death Canyon to a high divide overlooking Alaska Basin.

name: Death Canyon - Static Peak Divide Junction
quote: The Death Canyon to Static Peak Divide Junction Trail is a strenuous, 7.7 mi (12.4 km) RT out and back trail with 2,400 ft (730 m) of elevation gain.
why: Past Phelps Lake Overlook into Death Canyon, to the Static Peak junction.

name: Holly Lake
quote: Holly Lake is a strenuous, 12.8 mi (20.5 km) RT out and back hike with 2,840 ft (870 m) of elevation gain.
why: Up Paintbrush Canyon to a small alpine lake.

name: String Lake
quote: The String Lake Loop is an easy 3.7 mi (5.6 km) loop hike with 540 ft (160 m) of elevation gain.
why: A loop around String Lake with views of Mount St. John and Rockchuck Peak.

name: Leigh Lake
quote: The Leigh Lake Trail is an easy, 1.8 mi (2.9 km) RT out and back hike with 110 ft (30 m) of elevation gain.
why: A flat walk along String Lake to the south end of Leigh Lake.

name: Phelps Lake Loop
quote: The Phelps Lake Loop Trail is a moderate, 6.4 mi (10.3 km) RT loop hike with 1,060 ft (323 m) of elevation gain.
why: A loop around Phelps Lake from the Laurance S. Rockefeller Preserve.

name: Lake Creek - Woodland Trail Loop
quote: The Lake Creek-Woodland Trail Loop is an easy, 3 mi (4.8 km) RT loop hike with 770 ft (230m) of elevation gain.
why: An easy wooded loop toward Phelps Lake in the LSR Preserve.

name: Signal Mountain Trail
quote: The Signal Mountain Trail is a moderate, 6.7 mi (10.8 km) RT out and back hike with 980 ft (300 m) of elevation gain.
why: A winding climb up Signal Mountain above Jackson Lake.

name: Hermitage Point
quote: The Hermitage Point Trail is a moderately strenuous, 9.5 mi (15.3 km) loop hike with 930 ft (280 m) of elevation gain.
why: A long, fairly flat loop from Colter Bay out to a point on Jackson Lake.

name: Heron Pond - Swan Lake Loop Trail
quote: The Heron Pond-Swan Lake Loop is an easy, 3.1 mi (5 km) loop hike with 320 ft (100 m) of elevation gain.
why: An easy Colter Bay loop past two ponds.

name: Two Ocean Lake - Emma Matilda Lake Loop
quote: The Two Ocean Lake-Emma Matilda Lake Loop is a strenuous, 13.2 mi (21.2 km) loop hike with 1,960 ft (600 m) of elevation gain.
why: A long loop around two lakes east of Jackson Lake Junction.

name: Granite Canyon (Granite Canyon Trailhead)
quote: Granite Canyon is a strenuous, 13.4 mi (21.6 km) RT hike with 2,190 ft (670 m) of elevation gain.
why: Up Granite Canyon from the valley trailhead at the south end of the range.
